song.title: Spirit of the Living God (Vertical Worship)
song.lyrics:
[V1] Spirit of the living God Spirit of the living God We only want to hear Your voice We're hanging on every word
[V2] Spirit of the living God Spirit of the living God We want to know You more and more We're hanging on every word
[C1] Come and speak to us, oh Lord Spirit of the living God Spirit of the living God We only want to hear Your voice We're hanging on every word
[V3] Spirit of the living God Spirit of the living God We're leaning in to all You are Everything else can wait
[V4] Spirit of the living God Spirit of the living God Come now and breathe upon our hearts Come now and have Your way
[B1] 'Cause when You speak, and when You move When You do what only You can do It changes us It changes what we see and what we seek When You come in the room When You do what only You can do It changes us It changes what we see and what we seek You're changing everything
[B2] When You move, You move all our fears When You move, You move us to tears When You fall, we fall on our knees When You fall, we fall at Your feet
